summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: Package advertises itself as a small PostCSS selector-scoping plugin, but its preinstall lifecycle (`scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`) auto-executes on `npm install` and performs an alternate-runtime dropper flow. setup.mjs is variable-name obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers with inline string-lookup tables for URLs and commands); it downloads the Bun runtime archive from a github.com/oven-sh/bun release URL into a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit'})` to run the sibling file `math_init.js` under Bun. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily-obfuscated bundle using a shuffled string-array (`n7gIxM=[...]`) plus a `WV8StW` rotation decoder, with no readable source. A PostCSS plugin has no native-build or runtime reason to fetch a second language runtime, and executing an opaque obfuscated payload through that runtime — rather than through Node where standard scanners operate — is an evasion pattern. Installing the package results in execution of attacker-controlled, unreviewable code on the installer's machine with user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
